text:
Arjun: Adaptive redispatch landed in canary ✅. Initial numbers look promising — p99 latency down ~30% on small-request mixes and overall token cost ~-9%. Rolling at 5% traffic now. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/redispatch-canary

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started · id=canary-2026-03-23-01 · traffic=5% · config=adaptive_redispatch_v1

Maria: Huge — congrats! :tada: Any regressions on long sequences / chat-heavy workloads?

Arjun: Good question. We ran the long-seq suites overnight — no CPU spikes and KV-hit improved slightly. Quick perf delta snapshots: p50 45ms -> 32ms, p95 240ms -> 170ms, p99 520ms -> 360ms.

Jit: Can ops copy the exact config? Want to sync Dedicated/Docker overrides. :eyes:

Arjun: Putting the minimal ops snippet here:
```
dispatch:
  strategy: adaptive
  window_ms: 12
  max_inflight: 48
  favor_prefix: true
  fallback: static_v2
```

Elaine: Nice. I'll add short-term alerts: queue_latency > 120ms and cost_regression > 3% over 1h window. Also schedule a 24h A/B to validate tail behavior.

Arjun: Rollback thresholds: p99 delta > +10% OR cost delta > +8% (auto-roll). Canary so far shows token-cost delta -12% for low-seq models.

Maria: Can we call this out in the weekly all-hands if canary finishes clean? Product wants a one-slide summary. @Arjun will you draft?

Arjun: Yep — I'll draft a slide and a short benchmark post for #announcements after full rollout.

Jit: Where are the new metrics surfaced? I want to add them to the coalescer dashboard.

Arjun: Metrics are under the runtime/dispatch namespace: runtime.dispatch.redispatch.*. Quick link: https://dash.internal/redwood/metrics/runtime/dispatch

deploy-bot: Canary status: healthy · success_rate=99.98% · errors=0 · avg_response_ms=46

Elaine: Follow-ups noted: add alerts, backfill evals for problematic prompts, run 24h A/B, and update Dedicated docs. I'll create tasks. :white_check_mark:

Maria: Love it. Small, measurable win that compounds on cost. Great ship team — thanks everyone. :clap:
